items.name: Polynomial.coeff
items.type: {R : Type u} [Semiring R] : Polynomial R → ℕ →₀ R

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_ofFinsupp
items.type: {R : Type u} [Semiring R] (p : AddMonoidAlgebra R ℕ) : { toFinsupp := p }.coeff = p.coeff

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_inj
items.type: {R : Type u} [Semiring R] {p q : Polynomial R} : p.coeff = q.coeff ↔ p = q

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_update_same
items.type: {R : Type u} [Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) (a : R) : (p.update n a).coeff n = a

items.name: Polynomial.erase_same
items.type: {R : Type u} [Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) : (Polynomial.erase n p).coeff n = 0
